content:
iPhone 18 Pro 及 Pro Max will retain the screen sizes of the previous generation, but there are rumors that their displays will see improvements in two other areas. Here are the upcoming changes.

#1: LTPO+ Technology

LTPO is the technology that has long underpinned the iPhone's "Always-On Display" and ProMotion features. There are reports that Apple will switch to the more advanced LTPO+ on the iPhone 18 Pro.

The benefits of LTPO+ include more sensitive adjustments in low-light environments, thereby reducing screen flicker, along with better power-saving performance. As a result, iPhone 18 Pro users should be able to enjoy a more stable display with lower power consumption.

#2: Smaller Dynamic Island Cutout

The displays of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are also expected to feature a smaller Dynamic Island cutout, slightly increasing the available screen space.

The new Dynamic Island is rumored to be about 35% smaller than the one offered on the iPhone 17 Pro. This size has also been hinted at in the new Siri design in iOS 27.

Apple first introduced the Dynamic Island on the iPhone 14 Pro back in 2022. Although the software features related to the Dynamic Island and "Live Activities" have continued to expand over the years, the physical cutout itself has remained unchanged.

With the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, Apple is finally taking another step closer to the ideal of a "completely hole-less" display.

What other changes would you like to see in future iPhone displays? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
